name: Feeder Simulator
source:
An open ended visual novel about Feederism & Weight Gain.

Move into town, earn money, gain skills, and most importantly...
Help the current cast of 13 unique characters gain plenty of weight.
translation:
一部关于喂养主义和体重增加的开放式视觉小说。

搬进城镇，赚钱，获得技能，最重要的是……
帮助当前的13位独特角色获得足够的体重。
